bio: A small and well-kept bistro situated in the heart of Arona’s historic centre just a short walk from the lakefront. Here, a young, enthusiastic couple (Stefano in the kitchen and Melissa front of house) serve delicious, seasonal cuisine with a focus on local ingredients. Don’t miss the “Condividere” appetisers – a selection of small dishes in typical Italian antipasto style, including burrata with crispy puntarelle and anchovies, a Russian salad tartlet, lake fish bottarga, and other delicacies that are perfect for sharing....
